programs.title: Targeted for Murder
programs.desc: After a Midwestern insurance salesman is discovered on the floor of his office with an extra hole in his head, his wife, family, community, and church are drawn into a web of greed, infidelity, and murder.

programs.title: My Sister's Double Life
programs.desc: When Chelsea's sister vanishes after a late-night shift at a diner, she tries to convince the police that she's been abducted. Racing against the clock, she soon discovers that her sister's captor is now after her as well.

programs.title: Exile
programs.desc: Just prior to his release from prison, Ted Evans receives a threat from the man whose family he killed in a DUI. Believing the danger is real, Ted lives a reclusive life to protect his family.

programs.title: Campton Manor
programs.desc: A horror writer spends the night alone in a mansion to solve a decades-old mystery.
